item.title: We have lived in Marion County for 29 years and have watched Ocala become ‘mini Orlando’
item.description: "We have lived in Marion County for 29 years. It was before State Road 40 was widened to four lanes, and there was nothing commercially built before or after Stumpknockers. You could actually drive comfortably to your destination. Life was grand, it was about country folk, farms, and horses. It was actually referred to as the 'Breadbasket of Florida.' item.title: I am still in support of a food truck park in Marion County
item.description: "I felt that the proposed food truck park would have been beneficial to not just the surrounding area in our community, but to also support the vendors that would have their trucks parked there, giving the surrounding area and then some, a choice of different culture foods, which we don't have at all in the area. It would also give opportunity for growth in the area, as well as jobs. As of now, to experience different cultures of food from a Food Court Truck area, you have to travel to Orlando.
